name: pl-pacsquery
title: Pacs Query
description: An app to query a PACS using an intermediary REST service.

parameters.name: str_pfdcm
parameters.help: The PACS Q/R intermediary service IP:port.

parameters.name: str_msg
parameters.help: The actual complete JSON message to send to the Q/R intermediary service.

parameters.name: str_PACSservice
parameters.help: The PACS service to use. Note this a key to a lookup in "pfdcm".

parameters.name: str_summaryKeys
parameters.help: If specified, generate a summary report based on a comma separated key list.

parameters.name: str_summaryFile
parameters.help: If specified, save (overwrite) a summary report to passed file (in outputdir).

parameters.name: str_numberOfHitsFile
parameters.help: If specified, save (overwrite) the number of hits (in outputdir).

parameters.name: str_resultFile
parameters.help: If specified, save (overwrite) all the hits to the passed file (in outputdir).

parameters.name: str_man
parameters.help: If specified, print help on the passed key entry. Use "entries" for all key list
